ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: First describe the image: the image is “China Natural Disaster Zoning Map”, showing the outline of China, and using zoning boundary lines and Roman numerals to divide our country into several natural disaster zones; judging from the distribution on the map, the zoning is relatively prominent in areas such as the east, central part, and south where monsoon influence is relatively obvious and plains and river basins are relatively concentrated. Then reason: the question asks “what is one of the natural disasters that has the greatest impact on China”. The population and economy in eastern and southern China are dense, and they are obviously affected by monsoon precipitation, rainstorms, and river flooding, so one of the natural disasters with a wide impact range and great harm is flooding.

raw_record.question_text:
Read “China Natural Disaster Zoning Map”.

<image1>

What is one of the natural disasters that has the greatest impact on China?

method.method_draft: 先描述图像：图中中国被划分为若干自然灾害区，重点分区集中在东部、南部和中部的季风区及平原、河流流域附近。再读题干，题目问“对我国影响最大的自然灾害之一”。结合这些范围广、人口经济密集的区域容易受季风降水和河流泛滥影响，判断可填的重大灾害之一为“洪涝”。
method.CoT_raw: 先描述图像：图中是“我国自然灾害区划图”，显示中国轮廓，并用分区界线和罗马数字将我国划分为若干自然灾害区；从图面分布看，东部、中部、南部等季风影响较明显、平原和河流流域较集中的地区分区较突出。再推理：题干问“对我国影响最大的自然灾害之一是什么”。我国东部和南部人口、经济密集，受季风降水、暴雨和江河泛滥影响明显，因此影响范围广、危害大的自然灾害之一是洪涝。
method.CoT_answer_check_final: 先描述图像：图中是“我国自然灾害区划图”，显示中国轮廓，并用分区界线和罗马数字将我国划分为若干自然灾害区；从图面分布看，东部、中部、南部等季风影响较明显、平原和河流流域较集中的地区分区较突出。再推理：题干问“对我国影响最大的自然灾害之一是什么”。我国东部和南部人口、经济密集，受季风降水、暴雨和江河泛滥影响明显，因此影响范围广、危害大的自然灾害之一是洪涝。
method.CoT_qualify_0: 总体通过。推理顺序符合“先描述图像，再推理”，最终答案“洪涝”与标准答案一致，也基本遵循方法草稿。需要注意的是，图像本身主要能直接支持“中国自然灾害区划图、分区界线、罗马数字分区、东中南部有分区”等观察；“季风影响明显、平原和河流流域较集中、人口经济密集”更多属于地理背景知识和由区域位置引出的推断，不应表述成完全由图面直接显示。若修订，可将这些内容明确改为“结合我国地理常识”。
method.CoT_final: 先描述图像：图中是“我国自然灾害区划图”，显示中国轮廓，并用分区界线和罗马数字将我国划分为若干自然灾害区；从图面分布看，东部、中部、南部等季风影响较明显、平原和河流流域较集中的地区分区较突出。再推理：题干问“对我国影响最大的自然灾害之一是什么”。我国东部和南部人口、经济密集，受季风降水、暴雨和江河泛滥影响明显，因此影响范围广、危害大的自然灾害之一是洪涝。

planner_metadata.distinctiveness_rationale: This route is based on spatial extent and exposure shown by the zoning map: it identifies the broad eastern/central disaster region and then links that region to flood hazards. It differs from a pure textbook-recall route because the key evidence is the map’s coverage pattern.
planner_metadata.image_role: Inspect the map titled “我国自然灾害区划图”; note that the main divided disaster regions cover much of eastern and central China, including densely populated plains and river-basin areas, while some hazards would be more localized.
planner_metadata.text_role: Read the prompt as asking for one of the natural disasters with the greatest impact on China, not for a zone number or regional name.
planner_metadata.knowledge_role: Use geographic knowledge that eastern/central China lies in the monsoon region with large river systems and concentrated summer rainfall, so floods/waterlogging affect wide areas and large populations; among China’s natural disasters, 洪涝 and 干旱 are commonly identified as having the greatest impact.

method.CoT_final: 先描述图像：图中是一幅中国轮廓地图，内部按区域划分并标有 I、II、III、IV 等自然灾害分区，图下方标题为“我国自然灾害区划图”。再推理：题干问“对我国影响最大的自然灾害之一”，结合教材常识，我国影响最大的自然灾害通常包括洪涝和干旱。该小问只要求写其中一种，因此回答“洪涝”。

It is weakly distinct from the first because it relies more on the canonical textbook fact than on detailed spatial comparison.
planner_metadata.image_role: Use the image title and China disaster-zoning layout to confirm that the figure is a general national natural-disaster regionalization map rather than a single-hazard map.
planner_metadata.text_role: Use the wording “之一” to allow a single member of the standard pair of most influential disasters rather than requiring a full list.
planner_metadata.knowledge_role: Recall the standard junior geography statement: China is severely affected by natural disasters, and the two natural disasters with the greatest overall impact are generally summarized as 洪涝 and 干旱. Since the question asks for one of them and the expected part is the first one, give 洪涝.
